core_obligations: The adjunction (proof lines 6327-6334): the functor sending an object to its product with the localizing object is right adjoint to the localization functor, which the author verifies by the displayed identification of morphism sets.

Continuity (proof lines 6334-6343): for a covering of the site the stability axiom shows that the family obtained by taking the products with the localizing object is again a covering, which is exactly continuity.
The remaining assertions (proof lines 6343-6345): they follow from the two companion results once continuity is known.
proof_roadmap: Verify the adjunction by identifying the two morphism sets.
Check continuity using the stability axiom for coverings.
Apply the companion results for the description of the morphism of topoi and of the pushforward.
difficulty_reason: The lemma states that when the site has products of pairs, the localization functor has a continuous right adjoint given by the product with the localizing object, that this right adjoint defines a morphism of sites whose associated morphism of topoi is the localization, and that the pushforward is computed by evaluating at that product (statement lines 6310-6324). The proof is a short but complete argument: the adjunction is verified by the displayed identification of morphism sets (proof lines 6327-6334); continuity follows from the stability axiom applied to a covering (proof lines 6334-6343); and the remaining assertions follow from the two companion results (proof lines 6343-6345). The non-formal content is the adjunction and the continuity check. The claim is H1: two written-out verifications with the rest attributed.
